title: Find the names of superheroes who are taller than 85% of the average height
question: Find the names of superheroes who are taller than 85% of the average height of neutral-aligned heroes and possess more than 12 superpowers, ordered by their Speed attribute value in descending order.

prediction.sql:
SELECT T1."XCL_019"
FROM superhero AS T1
INNER JOIN hero_power AS T3 ON T1."XCL_018" = T3."XCL_012"
INNER JOIN hero_attribute AS T4 ON T1."XCL_018" = T4."XCL_009"
INNER JOIN attribute AS T5 ON T4."XCL_010" = T5."XCL_003"
WHERE T1."XCL_028" > 0.85 * (SELECT AVG(S."XCL_028") FROM superhero AS S INNER JOIN alignment AS A ON S."XCL_027" = A."XCL_001" WHERE A."XCL_002" = 'Neutral')
  AND T5."XCL_004" = 'Speed'
GROUP BY T1."XCL_018"
HAVING COUNT(T3."XCL_012") > 12
ORDER BY T4."XCL_011" DESC

      WHERE a2.XCL_004 = 'Height'

      SELECT hp2.XCL_012

      GROUP BY hp2.XCL_012
      HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT hp2.XCL_013) > 12
  )
ORDER BY (
    SELECT ha3.XCL_011

    JOIN attribute a3 ON ha3.XCL_010 = a3.XCL_003
    WHERE ha3.XCL_009 = s.XCL_018
      AND a3.XCL_004 = 'Speed'
